description: Desafio 02|26 - Movimentação de pessoas na área inundável por TSUNAMI is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Lisboa. Challenge sheet and data samples to be used by participants in challenge 0226 Movement of people in the flooded area by TSUNAMI in the city of Lisbon. Coverage: Município de Lisboa. The portal shows the English title as "Challenge 02|26 - Movement of people in the flooded area by TSUNAMI" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Lisboa. Its keywords include universidade, analitica, cidadao, lxdatalab, protecao-civil, dados-cm-lisboa-pt. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
